description: Scores a public Shopify store 0-100 for AI shopping assistants from its public catalog, robots.txt, policy pages and structured data, and returns the top issues with how to fix them. Read-only. Results are cached for 30 minutes; rate limited per client.

language.description: Language for issue text and grade (default en)

store_url.description: Store domain or URL, e.g. allbirds.com or mystore.myshopify.com

name: check_store_ai_readiness
title: Check a Shopify store's AI shopping readiness
